digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflow definitions and naming conventions
propositions: Several workflows carry lowercase non-descriptive name: values, making the GitHub Actions tab hard to scan and inconsistent.
Workflow name: fields should be rewritten to descriptive Title Case per a locked table, with reusable workflows keeping the leading-underscore marker.
Filenames should be standardized to lowercase-with-hyphens using the .yml extension; eval.yml is renamed to prompt-eval.yml and verify-identity.yaml to verify-identity.yml.
gerrit-verify.yaml and release.yml filenames must remain unchanged because Gerrit dispatch and PyPI OIDC trusted-publisher subject depend on them.
eval-plan-review-container.yml is closed-out scaffolding for a closed story and should be deleted along with its README reference.
All in-repo references to renamed workflows must be updated and validated by workflow-pinning tests and actionlint.
